mapper.select: SELECT ANALYSIS_ID AS "analysisId", ANALYSIS_NO AS "analysisNo", ANALYSIS_NAME AS "analysisName", ANALYSIS_PERIOD AS "analysisPeriod", BUDGET_ID AS "budgetId", BUDGET_AMOUNT AS "budgetAmount", ACTUAL_AMOUNT AS "actualAmount", VARIANCE_AMOUNT AS "varianceAmount", VARIANCE_RATE AS "varianceRate", VARIANCE_TYPE AS "varianceType", VARIANCE_REASON AS "varianceReason", IMPROVEMENT_MEASURES AS "improvementMeasures", ANALYST_ID AS "analystId", ANALYST_NAME AS "analystName", ANALYSIS_DATE AS "analysisDate", REMARK AS "remark" FROM TBL_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS WHERE ANALYSIS_NO = #{analysisNo} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}

SELECT ANALYSIS_PERIOD AS "period", SUM(VARIANCE_AMOUNT) AS "totalVariance", AVG(VARIANCE_RATE) AS "avgVarianceRate", COUNT(1) AS "analysisCount" FROM TBL_VARIANCE_ANALYSIS WHERE ANALYSIS_PERIOD BETWEEN #{startPeriod} AND #{endPeriod} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} GROUP BY ANALYSIS_PERIOD ORDER BY ANALYSIS_PERIOD
